rows.author: A048
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE COMMISSION ON PRE-SCHOOL EDUCATION, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: "The Commission on Pre-School Education Act of 1998". Seeks to promote and work for the development of preparatory school education in the country by way of prescribing and monitoring the curriculum on a periodic basis and constantly reviewing the instructional materials used to teach pre-school pupils. Defines "pre-school education" as a preparatory course requirement for pupils before enrolling in a formal elementary education such as, but not limited to, nursery or kindergarten.
rows.status: Substituted by HB11692

rows.author: A048
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT ALL HOSPITALS, CLINICS, HEALTH CENTERS AND OTHER SIMILAR ESTABLISHMENTS RENDERING MATERNITY SERVICES SHALL ESTABLISH LITERACY PROGRAMS FOR ALL EXPECTANT MOTHERS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Aims to assist expectant parents to start rearing intellectually their child fron conception by directing all hospitals, clinics, health centers and other similar establishments to establish reading and music corners equipped with reading materialssuch as nursery rhymes, bedrime stories and other children's books and where recorded music can be played.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A048
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE NATIONAL COMMISSION ON EMPLOYMENT AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Declares it a State policy to free the people from poverty and improve the quality of life for all through policies that promote full employment, thereby affording employment opportunities for all citizens who are willing and able to work.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: A048
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CENTER FOR TEACHER'S EXCELLENCE IN ALL THE LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Aims to upgrade the teaching skills and competence of all teachers to remedy the observation that there is a rapid decline in the quality of education in the country whic is attributed to the plight of the teachers that have been grossly neglected by the government.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C033
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CRITICAL NATIONAL RICE RESERVE FOR FOOD SECURITY, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Critical National Rice Reserve Act of 1998". Ensures an adequate supply of rice at reasonable and affordable prices for the people at all times especially in times, of calamities. Defines "critical national rice reserve" as the inventory of rice and/or palay by the National Food Authority (NHA), equivalent to ninety (90) days average national daily rice consumption to be maintained as a matter of national policy.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1998-07-29

rows.author: B004
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PROGRAM FOR THE CONSTRUCTION AND MAINTENANCE OF SCHOOL BUILDINGS IN THE PUBLIC ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY SCHOOLS NATIONWIDE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Schoolbuilding Act". Directs the DECS in coordination with the DPWH and other appropriate agencies to formulate a comprehensive and continuing schoolbuilding program which will address the problem of classroom shortage and provide not only the construction of adequate schoolbuilding facilities but also for the integration of all the necessary information for the effective monitoring and maintenance of existing schoolbuildings .
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION since 1998-07-29

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE AUTOMATIC HOLDING OF SPECIAL ELECTIONS WHENEVER A VACANCY OCCURS IN THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES , AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6645, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS 'AN ACT PRESCRIBING THE MANNER OF FILLING A VACANCY IN THECONGRESS OF THE PHILIPPINES,' AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7166
rows.abstract: Amends RA 6645 to eliminate the need for a resolution from the House of Representatives so that the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) can immediately hold special elections whenever a vacancy occurs in the House of Representatives upon receipt of anofficial communication from the Speaker of the House of Representatives certifying to the existence of such vacancy and calling for such special election.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05646

rows.author: B004
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE PRACTICE OF SPEECH PATHOLOGY IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: "Speech Pathology Law". Defines "speech pathology" as an allied medical profession which is devoted to the evaluation, diagnosis and management of human communications and "communication disorder" as impairment in the ability to receive and/or process symbol system, represent concepts in systems and transmit symbol systems which is manifested in hearing, language and/or speech processes.
rows.status: Substituted by HB12889

rows.author: B004
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING AN ADVANCED STUDIES DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM FOR EXCEPTIONAL EMPLOYEES FROM THE GOVERNMENT AND THE PRIVATE SECTOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The Pensionado Act of 1998". Seeks to develop a critical mass of first-rate specialists in various disciplines and areas of specialization vital to national development aimed at forming a national "think tank" who shall place continuously their knowledge and skills at the service of the nation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: B004
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE PROTECTION AND CONSERVATION OF ALL OBJECTS OF UNDERWATER CULTURAL HERITAGE IN THE PHILIPPINE WATERS
rows.abstract: "Protection of Underwater Cultural Heritage Act of 1998". Declares it a State policy to protect and preserve underwater archaeology, exploration and excavation, the description of items to be protected, the prohibition of certain activities in the vicinity of a protected item/site, the establishment of a reward system for verified reports and imposition of sanction/penalt ies for violations.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1998-07-29

rows.author: B004
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROTECT CAVE RESOURCES ON PUBLIC LANDS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "National Cave Resources Protection Act". Establishes and maintains increased cooperation and exchange of information between governmental authorities and those who utilize caves located on public lands for scientific, educational or recreational purposes.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07275

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO RATIONALIZE THE TEACHING OF RELIGION IN THE PUBLIC SCHOOLS
rows.abstract: Affirms the provision of the Constitution in Article VX, Section 8 (8) that recognizes the importance of religious instruction for children and wards in public elementary and high schools and because the State recognizes that teaching of religion plays a vital role in citizen formation.
